## Plugin reference

- Description: App shell for the Desktop: its identity, its entry in the app launchers (which switches the surface to the desktop mode instead of opening a tab) its own theme, which the desktop app selects, and the desktop's global shelf config (the apps kept in the dock). Desktop shell, server side: registers the desktop's global shelf config (the apps kept in the dock).
- Web:
  - Contributes:
    - `Apps.App` "Desktop"
